Markets.title: Nifty eyes 26,200 as rally strengthens; 6 sectors signal outperformance
Markets.summary: Driven by strong foreign investments and technical indicators, the Nifty surged 2.61% last week to eye a resistance level of 26,200. While banking, IT, and financial services are leading this momentum, analysts advise caution against chasing extended gains.

Markets.title: Stocks to buy: HSBC lists 19 Indian stocks that saw FY27 earnings upgrades, check target prices
Markets.summary: HSBC has given Buy ratings to 19 Indian stocks that received FY27 earnings upgrades following their second-quarter results. Ather Energy, GAIL, and IIFL Finance led these revisions amidst a broadening market recovery.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: These 13 stocks gained for 5 days in a row, all rose over 27%
Markets.summary: Thirteen stocks on the BSE 200 gained consecutively for five sessions ending November 20, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 27.51% to 31.02%. Sera Investments & Finance India led the group, while the broader Sensex index rose 1.08% during the same period.

Markets.title: AI to lead investment strategy in 2027; Energy and borrowing costs shape macro outlook: Barclays
Markets.summary: Barclays Private Bank reports that artificial intelligence will lead investment strategy by 2027. However, rising debt costs and potential computing shortages could negatively impact these projects.

Markets.title: Market winners: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers among 10 stocks that surged up to 14% in last week
Markets.summary: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers, and Blue Star led the Nifty 500 weekly gainers with surges of up to 14.14%. These ten stocks outperformed the broader index's 1.5% gain, driven by strong momentum across multiple sectors.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields drop for day and week; AI trade concern spurs safe-haven bid
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields dropped for both the day and the week as investor anxiety over the costs and debt associated with artificial intelligence triggered a flight to safety. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note fell below 5% for the first time in several months.

Geo-Political.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
Geo-Political.summary: A tech stock sell-off led by sliding Anthropic shares dragged US markets downward. This market pressure pushed both the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average into correction territory.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called Vladimir Putin a killer following Donald Trump's remarks praising his great relationship with the Russian leader. Trump had greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China earlier in the week.

Geo-Political.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
Geo-Political.summary: Delegates from nearly 200 nations are deadlocked at the COP31 climate talks. The nations cannot reach a new global climate agreement due to disagreements over fossil fuels.

Geo-Political.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
Geo-Political.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center database. Law enforcement agencies nationwide use this system to share criminal information.

Geo-Political.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
Geo-Political.summary: French police officers have been convicted for the 2020 beating of Black music producer Michel Zecler. The court ruled that the attack was aggravated by racism.

Geo-Political.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
Geo-Political.summary: A 30-year-old Los Angeles resident was convicted of arson for starting the Palisades fire. The resulting wildfire killed 12 people and destroyed over 6,800 buildings.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code to reverse engineer apps and games.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in generating organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to AI optimization.

Data & Insights.title: Budget expectations 2027: Gratuity hike, enhance social security, gig worker protection on list of trade union demands
Data & Insights.summary: Trade unions urged Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to raise retirement gratuities, increase minimum wages, and expand social security during a pre-Budget meeting. Their demands also include enhanced protections for gig workers.

Data & Insights.title: Undisclosed foreign assets? Taxpayers can declare multiple holdings for  ₹1 lakh
Data & Insights.summary: Taxpayers with undisclosed foreign assets up to ₹5 crore can declare multiple holdings under the FAST-DS scheme. The Central Board of Direct Taxes clarified this option in supplementary FAQs released on Friday.

Data & Insights.title: RBI eases export paperwork for individuals, sets cap for service exporters
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified export paperwork for individuals. It also established a specific payment cap for service exporters to clarify compliance and payment processing.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Look into wage stagnation’: DEA Secy Anuradha Thakur calls on India Inc to improve employee pay – here’s what she said
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur urged Indian businesses to address stagnant employee wages. She stated that better compensation would boost consumer spending and support economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur

Data & Insights.title: More economic red signals in October—but not everywhere, shows Mint tracker
Data & Insights.summary: The Mint economic tracker shows warning signals flashing across India in October, though producer and industrial segments remain resilient. The second half of the year is expected to be more difficult as the positive effects of GST rate cuts and interest rate reductions diminish.

India.title: BHU Medicine Purchases Under lens, Allahabad High Court Seeks Probe Reports
India.summary: The Allahabad High Court is seeking probe reports regarding alleged financial irregularities in medicine purchases at Banaras Hindu University. The court is hearing a Public Interest Litigation that demands an independent investigation and action against responsible officials.

India.title: RSSB Common Eligibility Test 12th Level Exam City Slip 2026 Released: Check Direct Link To Download
India.summary: The Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services Selection Board has released the exam city intimation slip for the 2026 Common Eligibility Test for 12th-level candidates. Candidates can download their exam city slips from the official Rajasthan SSO portal before the admit cards are issued in a few days.

India.title: India's First Deep Tech Hub To Be Opened At IIT Kanpur's Noida Campus
India.summary: India's first deep-tech hub will open at IIT Kanpur's Noida campus. The facility aims to convert specialized laboratory research into commercial products and companies to drive economic growth.

India.title: "Traditions Won't Be Compromised": Amit Shah To Arunachal Dam Protestors
India.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah arrived in Arunachal Pradesh on Friday for a two-day visit amid ongoing protests against the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. During his visit, Shah assured protestors that local traditions will not be compromised by the dam project.

India.title: 54-Year-Old Woman Raped, Killed In Train Coach. Gold Ring Helps Solve Case
India.summary: A 54-year-old woman was raped and murdered inside a train coach in India. Police identified the victim using a gold ring, which ultimately helped them solve the case.

India.title: Ganapati Puja At Tamil Nadu Police Station Triggers Political Row
India.summary: A Ganapati Puja held inside the Sathiyamangalam police station in Tamil Nadu has sparked a political controversy. The ritual was reportedly organized following an accident involving the station's sub-inspector and other untoward incidents in the area over the past month.

General.title: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says
General.summary: Ed Miliband stated that the broader agreement with the EU is not dependent on lowering tuition fees for EU students in Britain. This contradicts earlier suggestions from Brussels sources that the bloc might withhold the wider deal over the fees issue.

General.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called Vladimir Putin a killer after Donald Trump praised the Russian leader as a friend. Trump had earlier stated that he and Putin share a great relationship following a meeting in China.
